_README: Edit this file to control the published Family Tree, then re-upload all files to GitHub to apply changes for every visitor. Do not rename keys.
password_hash_note: SHA-256 of the admin password. Default is the hash of 'Ara12345'. To change it, log in as admin, use Change Password, then Download config.json and re-upload.
credits_note: Text shown on the welcome screen, directly under 'Presented by Raj Aravinthan'. Use it to credit contributors. For a line break, type \n (backslash-n) inside the text below.
credits: Credits: Rasalingam Vaithilingam (Australia), Yathavan Pathmanathan (Canada), Raghavan Eswaralingam (Canada), Aravinthan Rasalingam, Yasotharan Gnanalingam (New Zealand), Nanthakumar Singaravel (New Zealand), Janakan Rathakrishnan (Australia), Vaishnavi Koneswaran (Australia), Ramesh Satkunanathan (Australia) and growing...
tabs_note: true = visible to all visitors, false = hidden. You (logged in via the lock button) always see every tab regardless of these settings.
emailjs_note: Contact form delivery via EmailJS. The public key is safe to expose.
support_note: Optional donation page. Provide PayPal.Me and/or Stripe Payment Link URLs. Leave blank to hide buttons. Set tabs.support to true to show the page.

support.message:
This tool is free to use and always will be.

If you find it useful and would like to support its continued development, any contribution is genuinely appreciated. Donations help cover running costs, maintenance, licences, and the time needed to keep improving the project.

Thank you for your support — it truly helps.
